local_review.finding_body: The submitted statistics reported 0/6 covered dynamic-access calls, violating the above-20% gate for library-new-request contributions in §FS-contribution-contract.3.
local_review.finding_title: New-library contribution has zero dynamic-access coverage
local_review.fix_note: Added focused public-API tests for DHGroupData resource loading and DHGEXServer group-exchange negotiation, regenerated harness-produced metadata, and refreshed statistics. The repaired result covers both resource call sites for 2/6 overall coverage (33.333%).
local_review.review_comment: Checked the single-coordinate diff, test contract, metadata-file scope, index integrity, reported entry counts, local gate evidence, and resolved statistics. The repaired suite reports 2/6 dynamic-access calls covered (33.333%), and the exact Forge finalizer completed all three native lanes, metadata/style checks, generated-test validation, and statistics generation without further publishable changes. The native build flag was also verified as narrowly necessary: removing it reproducibly failed because sshd-common registers RootedFileSystemProvider through the JDK file-system-provider mechanism.
